**Coaching Note for Club Player:**

When your opponent attacks your rook, don't just move it to safety—look for an active capture! Here, your rook on c2 was under fire from the bishop on d3. Rather than retreating, **Rxc1** removes it from danger while winning material. After White recaptures with the rook, you've neutralized White's pressure and maintained your chances. The key lesson: threatened pieces can sometimes generate counterattacking chances through forcing moves.
